Model A.aspect_ratio_behavior: Adaptive (Portrait 2:3 for apparel, Square 1:1 for packaged products)
Model A.strengths: Exceptional prompt adherence, realistic Indian fabrics and draping, contextual ad layout typography, accurate jewelry and props
Model A.weaknesses: May occasionally introduce commercial text/branding unprompted (e.g. Milton, Haldiram's)

Model B.aspect_ratio_behavior: Predominantly widescreen landscape (16:9) with multi-panel / split compositions
Model B.strengths: Strong festive decor motifs (diyas, marigolds, rangoli), vibrant colors, natural lighting
Model B.weaknesses: Tendency to produce multi-panel composites (triptych, split shots) without being asked; wide aspect ratios ill-suited for vertical mobile ads

Model C.aspect_ratio_behavior: Strict widescreen landscape (16:9) leaving wide peripheral negative space
Model C.strengths: Crisp lighting and sharp object rendering
Model C.weaknesses: High rater disagreement; failures in cultural dress specifics (generated full-sleeved Bandhgala instead of sleeveless Nehru jacket); used wooden artist mannequin with ball joints
